samples.question: The image contains exactly two small dark rings; every light-grey mark is background clutter and must be ignored. Each dark ring's outline is broken by exactly one gap. Consider the straight line through the two dark rings' centres. For each dark ring decide whether its gap opens towards the other dark ring or away from it. The answer is facing if both gaps open towards each other, apart if both gaps open away from each other, and same-way if one gap opens towards the other ring while the other opens away, so that both gaps point the same way along that line. Answer unclear if either gap points within 17 degrees of perpendicular to that line. Which relation holds: facing, apart, same-way, or unclear?
